# Identify exact album with title 'Velvet Underground' from our search results
album_candidates = [a for a in all_albums if a.get('title') == 'Velvet Underground']
print('album_candidates:', [(a.get('album_id'), a.get('title')) for a in album_candidates])

album_id = album_candidates[0]['album_id'] if album_candidates else None
print('chosen_album_id:', album_id)

album_details = apis.spotify.show_album(album_id=album_id)
print('album_details_keys:', album_details.keys())
print('album_title:', album_details.get('title'))
print('songs_count:', len(album_details.get('songs', [])))
print('songs_first5:', [(s.get('id'), s.get('title'), [ar.get('name') for ar in s.get('artists', [])]) for s in album_details.get('songs', [])[:5]])

song_ids = [s['id'] if 'id' in s else s.get('song_id') for s in album_details.get('songs', [])]
print('song_ids:', song_ids)

# Fetch play_count for each song and find max
song_stats = []
for sid in song_ids:
    sd = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    song_stats.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': sd.get('title'), 'album_title': sd.get('album_title'), 'play_count': sd.get('play_count')})

# print sorted by play_count desc
song_stats_sorted = sorted(song_stats, key=lambda x: (x.get('play_count') is None, -(x.get('play_count') or 0)))
# Actually compute max
max_song = max(song_stats, key=lambda x: x.get('play_count') or 0)
print('top_by_play_count:', max_song)
# show all stats
print('all_song_play_counts:')
for st in sorted(song_stats, key=lambda x: x.get('play_count') or 0, reverse=True):
    print(' ', st['title'], 'play_count:', st.get('play_count'), 'song_id:', st['song_id'])
